shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx components/* tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short && rg -n 'force-dynamic|force-static|dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=' app components next.config.ts || true"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && rg -n 'force-dynamic|force-static|dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=' app components next.config.ts || true"
